notes:
- Hand Cannon: a proper big revolver: stainless frame, round barrel with an under-lug and a gold rib,
  walnut grip with a gold cap, and a fluted cylinder with six loaded rounds. The reload still swings the
  cylinder out, dumps the brass and seats a speedloader.
- Arc Zapper: white housing, a glowing energy core wound with copper coils, twin glowing prongs.
- Cryo Freezer: white housing, glowing frost fins, a nozzle bell with an emitter, a coolant tank with a
  frosted window, icicles.
- Seal Launcher: a fat blue tube with brass bands and glowing portholes, a carry handle with the sights
  on top, a fish-tin magazine and a little seal peeking out of the muzzle.
- Every gun in the game is now a realistic model (the Seal Launcher's sights moved onto its carry handle,
  so it aims a little higher than before).
